purpose: Quarantine by default, or explicitly delete, exactly one hash-bound run-owned failed file.
trigger: Use only when a failed artifact is proven run-owned and is not baseline/evidence.

inputs.name: ownership
inputs.description: Trusted ownership record or run ID; alternatively artifact_run_ref.

inputs.name: artifact_run_ref
inputs.description: Trusted owner run reference; must equal run_ref.

inputs.name: failure_record
inputs.description: Associated failure; caller must ensure attribution if path/run fields are absent.

inputs.name: quarantine_dir
inputs.description: New/existing quarantine directory inside run_root; default .quarantine.

inputs.name: mode
inputs.description: quarantine default (recoverable); delete only on explicit single-file deletion request.

preconditions: Caller supplies trustworthy ownership/failure attribution and retains the failure record. No size/timestamp field or durable log is produced. Compatibility aliases path, expected_hash, evidence_path exist; use canonical fields here.
Caller has established the actual run scope and trustworthy input provenance.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: passed; EX13 returns blocked/eligible and ER11 quarantined/deleted.

outputs.name: ownership_verified
outputs.description: True relative to trusted caller record.

outputs.name: failure_record_preserved
outputs.description: The supplied record was not modified; caller retains it durably.

outputs.name: recoverable
outputs.description: True for quarantine, false for deletion.

postconditions: Quarantine by default, or explicitly delete, exactly one hash-bound run-owned failed file.
Only the declared flat result fields are returned; no desktop or unperformed persistence layer is implied.

implementation.target_environment: Windows host tooling; no SpaceClaim control or geometry mutation is implied.
implementation.notes: Call remove_run_owned_failed_artifact(**payload), or dispatch("ER-11", payload). Rejected inputs raise HostActionError (with code); filesystem failures may propagate OSError. Caller supplies trustworthy ownership/failure attribution and retains the failure record. No size/timestamp field or durable log is produced. Compatibility aliases path, expected_hash, evidence_path exist; use canonical fields here. The linked guide uses conceptual fields; explicitly adapt them to this canonical function interface, never dispatch the guide output directly.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable; the operation does not mutate model topology.

failure_modes.condition: Resolved path is not one safe run-owned regular file.

failure_modes.detection: File remains or post-delete identity is ambiguous.
failure_modes.safe_state: Do not retry or delete adjacent paths.

recovery.action: Record uncertain cleanup and request review.

validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: Only specified file is removed and cleanup record preserves prior identity/reason.

evidence_level.notes: Deterministic host file/event tests passed; one Windows symlink creation test skipped for missing platform privilege. No desktop observation implied.
